artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the spine label is completely illegible and structurally nonsensical. Characters are malformed, fused, and do not form any recognizable alphabet or word. This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without understanding typography.
The leather-like texture is slightly repetitive and lacks the fine, random micro-details of real leather. It has a 'painted' or overly uniform quality typical of diffusion models.
The top edge where the pages meet the cover is slightly soft and ill-defined. The separation between individual pages is blurred into a solid block rather than showing distinct sheet edges.
